name: String Art Envelopes
desc: Curve-stitching string art: hundreds of straight translucent threads laced between nails on rotating circles weave into glowing cardioid, nephroid and mystic-rose envelope curves whose connection offset drifts so the caustics endlessly breathe and morph; renders as multi-hue neon, gold-silk, cyan blueprint, spectral rose, or white thread on black.

density.doc: nail count / thread density (higher = denser mesh)

weave.doc: envelope order — connection multiplier k (cardioid -> high-order rose)

families.doc: number of layered thread families (different hues/centers)
